title: Final Credit Figure for Advantage Lost or Stolen Card Claims, Paystride Visa Payroll Card
content:
On the Paystride Visa Payroll Card Advantage plan, the final credit is the claimed transfer less the cardholder's liability, rounded half up to the cent once at the end.

| Quantity | Definition |
|---|---|
| Claimed transfer | the disputed amount less any ATM owner surcharge rebate posted on the claimed transaction, never below zero |
| Liability | the lesser of the disputed amount and the liability limit; the liability limit is the plan's liability cap for a loss reported on time |
| Final credit | the claimed transfer with the liability taken off, never below zero |

As the only claim of its loss resolved with an error found, the claim carries the loss's liability first.

**Combination.** Any adjustment that replaces a figure of this method applies first. Any adjustment that adds an amount to the credit applies after it, to the credit figured at no less than zero. Rounding half up to the cent happens once, at the end.

*Worked example (hypothetical; liability cap for a timely report 50.00):* a disputed teller cash withdrawal of 221.84 with no rebate. The liability is the lesser of 221.84 and 50.00, which is 50.00, and the final credit is 171.84. For a disputed ATM withdrawal of 64.10 with a surcharge rebate of 1.80, the claimed transfer is 62.30, the liability 50.00, and the credit 12.30.
